subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion - Call Recap and Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecorp.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion - Call Recap and Next Steps

Hi Sarah / Tom

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything in one place. Happy to adjust if I missed anything.

What we covered
- Current footprint: ~40M tokens/month, mostly inference for chat and knowledge search.
- Pain points: rising per-token cost during peak traffic, occasional tail-latency spikes for longer documents, and concern about query routing between regions.
- Goals for renewal: lock in predictable pricing for year ahead, add dedicated capacity for the new customer-facing product ("Acme Assist") to guarantee 99th percentile latency, and enable private VPC deployment for the EU data flow.
- Potential expansion: Additional 2-3 dedicated GPU nodes for the Assist workload initially, and a pilot of Redwood Optimize automatic batching to reduce per-token cost by 15-25%.

Action items / timeline
1) Marissa: Share draft Master Purchasing Order (MPO) with proposed commitment and pricing (attached) - by EOD today.
2) Rishi: Technical runbook for Assist (latency SLOs, KV cache plan, region routing) - by 2027-03-19.
3) Monica: Draft onboarding plan and required info for private VPC setup (networking checklist, PKI/KMS questions) - by 2027-03-17.
4) Sarah / Tom: Confirm internal approval path and target renewal decision date (they mentioned mid-April) - by 2027-03-19.

Attachments: ACME_Renewal_Draft_MPO_v1.pdf (proposed commit/pricing), acme_q1_usage_report.csv (usage export from this morning).

If that aligns, I'll queue the MPO with Legal and send the DocuSign link for signatures once we have sign-off. Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Renewal & Expansion - Call Recap and Next Steps

Thanks Marissa - this is great and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications from our end: 

- We need the dedicated nodes to be provisioned in us-west for the first 60 days (we plan to route 80% of Assist traffic there while we ramp). After the pilot, we may replicate to us-east.
- For the EU VPC: we have a separate legal review team; they will need the SOC2 evidence and an explicit data retention policy for the EU traffic. Monica - we will coordinate directly on the networking questions; we should include our security reviewer (cc'd in a follow-up) before DocuSign.
- Timeline: mid-April decision is still accurate but we may push to the week of Apr 19 if our procurement has extra gating.

On the MPO: the numbers look reasonable preliminary, but I'd like line-item clarity on the burst capacity fees and the on-demand vs reserved splitting. Can you call that out in version 2?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
Sarah.Lee@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecorp.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ACME Renewal & Expansion - Call Recap and Next Steps

Hi Sarah - great, thanks for the clarifications. Quick replies inline below and next steps: 

- us-west provisioning: noted. Rishi - we'll prioritize initial nodes in us-west and keep replication for later.
- EU legal & SOC2: Monica will share SOC2 attestation and the Redwood data retention summary. Monica - can you also prepare a short note on KMS options we support (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed)?
- MPO version 2: I've added a short appendix to the attached v1 that calls out burst fees and the split between reserved vs on-demand. I'll push v2 by Monday EOD (2027-03-15) with clearer line items.

DocuSign: We won't send the signature request until you confirm internal reviewers. I can, however, provision a placeholder DocuSign link so procurement can review the flow.

Cheers,
Marissa
